issue_context.title: stop baseline capture for queries known to contain invalid hints
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

If we turn on the `tidb_capture_plan_baselines`, and execute a query which contains invalid hints twice, there would be a lot of logs in the background like the following:

```
[2020/11/14 09:48:16.006 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
[2020/11/14 09:48:19.006 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
[2020/11/14 09:48:22.007 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
[2020/11/14 09:48:25.008 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
[2020/11/14 09:48:28.006 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
[2020/11/14 09:48:31.007 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
[2020/11/14 09:48:34.006 +08:00] [INFO] [handle.go:641] ["capture baseline failed"] [SQL="SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(v@sel1) */ * FROM (select null) v NATURAL LEFT JOIN (select null) v1"] [error="Unknown query block name in hint hash_join(`v`@`sel1`)"]
```

We'd better figure out an approach to identify these queries containing invalid hints and ignore them in baseline capture.
comments:
If we add a capture filter for the processed queries, there still exist corner cases which have tricky behaviors. For example, if we have already manually created a binding for a query, then baseline capture would not generate captured binding for this query, then if we don't want the original manual binding anymore, capture would still not work even if we delete that binding in mysql.bind_info because of the capture filter.

Also, the lifetime of capture filter is a tricky problem to deal with.

Since the recommended usage of baseline capture is to turn it on, run workloads and then turn it off, I prefer not to add this kind of capture filter. Instead, we change the log level to DEBUG to avoid log flooding in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/21351.

review_comments:
I suggest using the error level here since these errors are expected to occur barely and no user uses the debug log level in the production environment. 
If these errors occur in the production environment, there is no log left then and it's hard for us to investigate.

I changed all the log levels to DEBUG for SQL bind, because SQL bind is a background job, there would be potential log flooding if a query went wrong, just as the referenced issue, users may do not want to see those logs when their bindings are actually working well. If users observe abnormality of SQL bind, DBA can turn on the DEBUG logs for investigation? @SunRunAway @nullnotnil any thoughts on the log level?
